title: Optimization of capital injections and absolutely continuous dividend payments in a diffusion model
summary: We investigate a joint optimization problem of dividend payments and capital injections for a surplus process driven by a general diffusion. Dividend payments are assumed to be absolutely continuous in time, with the dividend rate bounded by a nonnegative concave function of the current surplus; while capital injections are modelled by a general nondecreasing process. We first analyze an auxiliary bail-out problem in which capital injections are required to keep the surplus nonnegative at all times.
